mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM prd_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND task_status IN ('INIT', 'PROCESS')

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(task_status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(task_status = 'FAIL'), 0) AS fail, COALESCE(SUM(task_status = 'CANCELED'), 0) AS canceled, COALESCE(SUM(DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS todayTotal, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, finish_time) END), 0) AS avgDurationSeconds FROM prd_task WHERE deleted = 0
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
